summary.label_level_note: On the label itself (compulsory NC) FOR: McKinnell, Davies, Hayes (all Lab); AGAINST: O'Brien, Trott, Timothy, Spencer, Stafford, Hinds (Con) and Siobhain McDonagh (Lab) - a same-party split (Lab) exists on the label, not on a finer measure.
summary.answer: Mostly neither scarcity nor hidden finer-measure fights: of 30 NEITHER claims 10 (33%) have no position, 12 (40%) are on finer/different measures but those are one-sided, 8 (27%) are clear on-label positions the judge dropped (7 matching extractor, 1 opposite). Representation loss exists but is mainly judge misses on-label and grouping noise.
